title: rate-engine #410: Fall back to state-to-state lanes when no ZIP3 lane exists
input:
Fall back to state-to-state lanes when no ZIP3 lane exists

Quotes for new ZIP3 pairs fail with 404 "no lane for this route" even though pricing has state-to-state rates for most of them. This adds a fallback: exact ZIP3 pair first, then origin state to destination state.

- lookupDB queries both keys and takes the most specific row (specificity column from migration 0042)
- zip3State covers the pilot states only (IL, TX, IN, OR) until pricing loads the rest
- test for the state fallback

Closes RATE-311.

output.title: Fall back to state-to-state lanes when no ZIP3 lane exists (#410)
output.summary: The fallback query does what the description says, and the index from migration 0042 covers it. One real problem: an error while reading rows turns into ErrNoLane, which the quote handler returns as a 404, so database trouble would look like missing lanes. Lanes and server tests pass. Requesting the switch to QueryRowContext.
